Error.UnauthorizedAccess.Title: ❌ Insufficient Permissions
Error.UnauthorizedAccess.Message: The program does not have sufficient permissions to perform this operation
Error.UnauthorizedAccess.Solution:
• Right-click the program icon and select "Run as administrator"
• Check file or folder permission settings
• Ensure the target location is not a system-protected directory
Error.DirectoryNotFound.Title: ❌ Directory Not Found
Error.DirectoryNotFound.Message: The specified directory or its parent directory does not exist
Error.DirectoryNotFound.Solution:
• Check if the path is correct
• Ensure the parent directory exists
• Try creating the directory manually
Error.FileNotFound.Title: ❌ File Not Found
Error.FileNotFound.Message: The specified file could not be found
Error.FileNotFound.Solution:
• Check if the file path is correct
• Confirm the file has not been deleted or moved
• Try recreating the file
Error.PathTooLong.Title: ❌ Path Too Long
Error.PathTooLong.Message: The file or directory path exceeds Windows length limit (248 characters)
Error.PathTooLong.Solution:
• Choose a shorter path
• Move files closer to the disk root
• Use shorter file or folder names
Error.DiskFull.Title: ❌ Insufficient Disk Space
Error.DiskFull.Message: The target disk does not have enough available space
Error.DiskFull.Solution:
• Free up disk space (delete temp files, uninstall unused programs)
• Choose a different disk as the target
• Run disk cleanup tool
Error.FileInUse.Title: ❌ File In Use
Error.FileInUse.Message: The file is currently being used by another program
Error.FileInUse.Solution:
• Close programs that may be using the file
• Restart the computer and try again
• Use Task Manager to end related processes
Error.IOException.Title: ❌ File System Error
Error.NotSupported.Title: ❌ Operation Not Supported
Error.NotSupported.Message: The path format is incorrect or contains illegal characters
Error.NotSupported.Solution:
• Check for illegal characters in the path
• Use standard file path format
• Avoid using special symbols
Error.Security.Title: ❌ Security Restriction
Error.Security.Message: System security policy has blocked this operation
Error.Security.Solution:
• Check system security policy settings
• Run the program as administrator
• Contact your system administrator
Error.Argument.Title: ❌ Invalid Argument
Error.Argument.Message: The provided path or parameter format is incorrect
Error.Argument.Solution:
• Check the input path format
• Ensure parameters meet requirements
• Refer to examples in documentation

Memory optimization can free up occupied memory space and improve system responsiveness. Expected effects:
• Free up 200-500MB memory space
• Reduce memory fragmentation
• Improve application startup speed
• Enhance multitasking smoothness
PerfBoost.EffectDesc:
Performance optimization improves overall performance by adjusting system settings. Expected effects:
• Increase game FPS by 5-15%
• Reduce input latency
• Decrease background process usage
• Optimize system responsiveness

Note: Extreme optimizations may affect system stability, please choose according to your situation.
Welcome.Title: Welcome to Yuqi Engine
Welcome.Step1.Title: Free Software
Welcome.Step1.Content:
Yuqi Engine is free software.
If someone sold this app to you, please report the seller and do not pay.
Welcome.Step2.Title: Backup Before Optimizing
Welcome.Step2.Content: This software modifies system-level settings to optimize performance. We strongly recommend creating a system restore point before optimization for quick recovery if issues occur.
Welcome.Step2.BackupSteps:
1. Open Settings → System → About
2. Click System Protection → Create Restore Point
3. Or enable Auto Backup in software Settings
Welcome.Step3.Title: How It Works & Effects
Welcome.Step3.Content:
How It Works:
By adjusting CPU scheduling, memory management, network priority and other system-level parameters, we reduce system latency and unnecessary background usage to allocate more resources to game processes.

Real Experience:
With reduced system latency, mouse movements feel more responsive, visuals become smoother and silkier, and operations respond more quickly. Regardless of your PC specs, you'll notice improved operational experience.

Effect Disclaimer:
Optimization effects vary by hardware, system environment and game type, but provide positive results for most users.
Welcome.Step4.Title: Support the Author
Welcome.Step4.Content:
If Yuqi Engine helps you, feel free to buy the author a coffee ☕
No charge required; sharing this project also helps a lot.

Guide.Overview.Step1.Title: Welcome to Yuqi Engine
Guide.Overview.Step1.Content: This is your control center where you can view system status, hardware info, and quick actions. Let's quickly explore the main features.

Guide.Overview.Step2.Content: View your PC configuration including CPU, memory, graphics card and other hardware details to understand device performance.

Guide.Repair.Title: System Repair Guide
Guide.Repair.Description: Learn how to use system repair features

Guide.Repair.Step1.Content: Click the scan button and the system will automatically detect common system issues and configuration errors.

Guide.Cleanup.Step1.Content: Click the scan button and the system will automatically find temporary files, cache and other cleanable content.

Guide.Backup.Step1.Content: All created system restore points are displayed here, including creation time and backup description.

Guide.Backup.Step3.Content: Select a restore point and click the restore button to revert the system to the backup state.

Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step2.Title: Core Profile List
Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step2.Content: View created core affinity profiles. Each profile can assign optimal CPU cores for specific games.
Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step3.Title: Create New Profile
Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step3.Content: Click this button to create a new core affinity profile and specify which CPU cores the game should run on.
Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step4.Title: Auto Monitoring
Guide.CoreAccelerator.Step4.Content: When enabled, the system will automatically monitor game processes and apply corresponding core affinity profiles.

FirstProtection.Header: Welcome to YuqiEngine: establish recovery protection first
FirstProtection.Subtitle: Create a backup now, or handle it later. Normal app use remains available.
FirstProtection.Hint: Skipping does not lock features. Without a verified baseline, each operation explains recovery limits and requires a one-time risk acknowledgement; permission, capability, confirmation, and failure checks remain active.
